text:
Alex: quick alert after the 1834560000 runtime rollout, P95 for tool/schema validation spiked on a few routes that emit structured outputs. saw ~3x at p95.
Priya: which routes are affected? p50/p95 numbers? any link to longer outputs or retry churn?
Alex: mainly /chat/tool-run and /batch/transform. p50 is fine, p95 jumped from ~8ms -> ~24ms for the tool_validate step. p99 is all over the place.
Carlos: infra-bot shows deploy at 1834560000, runtime v2.7.3. no other infra rollouts except config tweak.
infra-bot: Deploy event: runtime v2.7.3 deployed to prod at 2026-03-18T20:00:00Z by @DevOps. Config diff: batching.window_ms: 8 -> 12, kernel_chooser: sample_based -> heuristic_v2
Emily: batching.window bump could add schedule jitter, but tool_validate jumping that much smells like validation work happening extra times (retries?).
Sasha: ran a lightweight profiler (5% sample) across tool-call paths, rough numbers: 
```nStage                avg(ms)  p95(ms)
decode               0.8      1.4
kernel_select        0.6      1.8
batch_schedule       2.3      8.7  <-- up since deploy
kv_cache_lookup      0.4      0.9
tool_validate        6.5      24.2  <-- main regressor
serialize            0.9      2.1
```
Sasha: digging into validate, it's mostly JSON Schema validation of structured outputs and the JSON lib redoing expensive checks on partial/streamed outputs when retries happen.
Priya: wait are we running full validation on retries? iirc we had an optimization to skip validation for retry frames if the schema candidate didn't change.
Carlos: traces show ~12% of tool calls have a single retry due to kernel preemption. currently retry path re-enters full validation flow. that's doubling/tripling validation cost for those tails.
Alex: we should short-circuit validation on retry when schema candidate unchanged. small code change, high impact.
Emily: also note kernel_chooser: heuristic_v2 tends to pick kernel variants that touch KV cache differently for long sequences, increasing cache miss rate -> longer exec -> more preemptions -> more retries. batching.window increase compounds it (higher scheduling variance).
Priya: suggested PromQL for per-route P95 token latency (5m rolling):
```nhistogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_token_latency_seconds_bucket{route=~"/.*(tool|transform).*"}[5m])) by (le, route))
```
Priya: dashboard shows tool routes diverging right after the deploy window.
Sasha: small trace snippet (pseudo):
```ncall_start -> kernel_select -> batch_schedule -> kv_lookup -> tool_exec -> validate_schema -> serialize -> send
retry -> kernel_select -> batch_schedule -> kv_lookup -> tool_exec -> validate_schema -> serialize -> send
```
Sasha: proposal: change retry path to skip validate_schema if schema candidate and payload shape identical, i.e. 
```nretry -> kernel_select -> batch_schedule -> kv_lookup -> tool_exec -> serialize -> send
```
Carlos: +1. also add an emergency feature flag to revert batching.window back to 8ms if we see sustained regression.
DevOps: i can stand up a rollback flag. want me to flip it immediately or wait for the validation short-circuit?
Alex: prefer short-circuit first (lower blast radius). DevOps, stand by to flip batching.window if no improvement in 30m. ping at 1834568050.
Priya: i'll open a tiny PR to skip validation on retry and add a safety check: if output length/schema hash differs, run full validation. ETA ~45m. includes unit tests.
Emily: i'll update the token-level dashboard to add stacked series for tool_validate / kernel_select / batch_schedule per-route, and a retry-rate gauge. this will help spot recurrence.
Carlos: dashboard suggestion: annotate deploy and show retry-rate query: 
```nsum(rate(runtime_toolcall_retries_total[2m])) by (route)
```
Alex: Sasha, can you pin a few slow traces to the slowtrace dash and upload the flamegraphs? ops wants examples.
Sasha: done. pinned 15 trace samples and uploaded flamegraphs + one full-span trace id list on the incident card.
DevOps: rollback flag ready; will flip at 1834568050 on command.
Priya: PR created: runtime/skip-validation-on-retry, feature toggle default off, tests included.
Alex: great. we'll wait 30m post-PR and monitor P95. if it doesn't improve, we flip batching.window. reconvene in 30. thanks all :thumbsup:
